R308_state: BUYER_TESTABLE (744 μW at 940nm, PASS, MCX cross-check pending)
R308_evidence_summary: Reported 744 μW at 940nm. Internal model uses diffusion approximation. R308 audit found 60-70% disagreement between diffusion approximation and Kubelka-Munk. Both are internal approximations — NOT independent verification.
R309_role: P-16 is the canonical case for Article XXXVI §6 (standard simulator registry) and §7 (independent verification). The R308 disagreement is exactly why the standard engine mandate exists.

R308_disagreement_diagnosis.root_cause_hypothesis: Diffusion approximation is valid only when scattering >> absorption and source is far from detector. At 940nm in CSF/brain tissue, neither condition may hold strongly, so the diffusion approximation over-estimates fluence at the PV cell.
R308_disagreement_diagnosis.R309_resolution: Use MCX (Monte Carlo gold standard for tissue optics) + PyTissueOptics (independent Python implementation) + published 940nm tissue-transmission measurements (Jacques 2013 or equivalent). MCX is the tiebreaker. Published measurement is ground truth.

step_1_preregistration.reference_case: Published NIR 940nm transmission through 5mm tissue phantom (Jacques 2013)
step_1_preregistration.preregistration_timestamp: MUST be recorded BEFORE any MCX run

R309_protocol.step_2_run_our_implementation: Diffusion approximation model on reference case (5mm tissue, 940nm source). Record fluence at detector position.
R309_protocol.step_3_run_MCX: Same phantom geometry, same source, same optical properties (μa, μs, g, n at 940nm). MCX Monte Carlo simulation. Record fluence at detector.
R309_protocol.step_4_run_PyTissueOptics: Same phantom. Independent Python Monte Carlo. Record fluence at detector.
R309_protocol.step_5_compare_to_published: Jacques 2013 (or equivalent) measured 940nm transmission through 5mm tissue phantom. Compare all three model outputs to the published measurement.

step_6_verdict.MODEL_VERIFIED: If our implementation, MCX, PyTissueOptics, and published measurement all agree within 10% relative / 0.05 mW/cm² absolute. P-16 progresses with VERIFIED power output (likely the lower number, not 744 μW).
step_6_verdict.MODEL_DISAGREEMENT: If our implementation disagrees with MCX/PyTissueOptics/published. Root cause analysis (likely: diffusion approximation invalid for this geometry). Resolution: upgrade our model to Monte Carlo (use MCX output as our model), re-preregister, re-verify.

R309_protocol.step_7_final_economic_claim: Use the VERIFIED power output, NOT the attractive 744 μW. If verified output is 300 μW, P-16's economic claim is based on 300 μW. Article XXXVI §8: central value claim must use verified number.

R309_anti_pattern_forbidden.choosing_the_attractive_result: If diffusion approximation gives 744 μW but MCX gives 300 μW, the answer is 300 μW (or whatever the published measurement supports). Choosing 744 μW because it is more attractive is a constitutional violation under Article XV (must disclose inconvenient results) and Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion).

R309_target_state: TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY with VERIFIED power output (whatever it is)
success_criterion: P-16 becomes the demonstration that the standard simulator registry works. If P-16 cannot be verified, the entire Article XXXVI §6 framework needs review.
